title: Magical Girl Apocalypse
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Bored high-schooler Kii Kogami watches a gothic-lolita 'magical girl' massacre his class and reanimate the dead as a chanting zombie horde. He flees with his bullied childhood friend Tsukune and a band of survivors as the magical girls overrun the world. Mysteries about Tsukune's lineage, time travel and the girls' origin drive a gore-heavy horror story with fan service.
life_message: In a collapsing world, survival depends on trust and courage, and wishing for excitement out of boredom can cost everything.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Grudges and bullying feuds surface among survivors (Wikipedia: Kaede, Miki, Tsukune).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Social order collapses; survivors improvise (MU Lawlessness).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Loyalty to childhood friends and small group.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Ad hoc survivor group, little formal rank.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Secular setting; magical lineage a mystery element.

folkways.japan: School-class social hierarchy, ijime bullying and the subversion of the Japanese magical-girl (mahou shoujo) genre frame the story.

delivery.evidence: Horror spectacle drives the story (AniList Gore, Zombie, Survival); no source comments on delivery (to verify)
delivery.note: Any message about boredom and courage sits under survival horror and is not argued out.

winners_losers: Survivors win only small reprieves while most of the cast dies; bullies and passive bystanders are exposed, and the story's sympathy goes to those who protect others.
